<!--
  pyramid_level — where this document sits in the documentation pyramid (docs/README.md):

    constitutional   Rare; reserved for amendments to overview constitutional documents
    architecture     docs/01-architecture/ and cross-cutting models
    specification    RFCs, stable specs, test vectors, conformance documents

  constitutional_refs — paths to constitutional documents this spec depends on or must
    not contradict. Typical values when applicable:

    - docs/00-overview/MANIFESTO.md
    - docs/00-overview/VISION.md
    - docs/00-overview/PRINCIPLES.md
    - docs/00-overview/GLOSSARY.md

  Leave constitutional_refs empty only when the document is itself part of the
  constitutional layer or is purely operational metadata (e.g. governance process).
-->
